fomod.Name: Skyrim Together Next
fomod.Author: komAAmok
fomod.Description:
Skyrim Together 的联机 mod(1.5.x / 1.6.x / 1.7.x)。装上后从 MO2 启动 skse64_loader.exe 即可,SKSE 插件会自动部署运行时。联机:房主开服务器,其他玩家游戏内按 F2 输入房主 IP:10578。
Multiplayer mod for Skyrim (1.5.x / 1.6.x / 1.7.x). Launch skse64_loader.exe through MO2 - the SKSE plugin deploys the runtime on first start. To play: the host runs the server, everyone else presses F2 in game and enters the host IP:10578.
